Name: LIGENTEC
Description: LIGENTEC is a B2B company manufacturing Photonic Integrated Circuits (PIC) for customers in high-tech areas such as AI, Quantum technologies, LiDAR and Biosensors. LIGENTEC commercialises the all-nitride-core technology. With the all-nitride-core technology  LIGENTEC enables the customers to develop their products in the industrial revolution 4.0. Our customers benefit from a clear path to volume production while obtaining the small quantities of wafers with the performance, short turn around and high yield required at the early stage of proof of concept.

Name: Nanosurf
Description:
Nanosurf -- Zoom into the Future

Nanosurf is a company that thrives on challenges at the frontier of what is physically achievable. By concentrating our collective efforts on the obstacles that stand in the way of advancements in nanotechnology, we enable researchers to push the boundaries in their respective fields of science. We integrate cutting-edge scanning probe technology into the value chain of industrial customers by crafting custom machines that seamlessly blend into their manufacturing processes. Our bespoke solutions not only meet the unique needs of each client but also enhance efficiency and precision in their production lines.

Established in 1997, Nanosurf defined ease of use in scanning probe microscopy by miniaturizing the size of a scanning probe microscope to fit a coffee table. Since then, the Swiss-based company has matured into one of the leading innovators in atomic force microscopy. Nanosurf provides continually evolving instrument platforms for academic researchers and industry applications in life science and materials science, as well as large-scale customized industrial solutions for use in production lines with very demanding accuracy specifications.

Nanosurf will continue to focus development efforts on new measurement modes and technologies that make atomic force microscopes an easier, faster, and more reliable tool. It is also our mission to bring the technique to an ever-increasing range of new application areas by making it as accessible and intuitive to new users as more common technologies such as optical microscopy. Together, we tackle the challenge.

Nanosurf is part of Lab14 Group, a group of successful high-tech companies providing advanced manufacturing solutions with complementary products and services for a wide range of applications that require demanding solutions for nano- and microfabrication and surface analysis.

Name: EULITHA
Description: EULITHA provides nanolithography services and equipment for research and production. Our revolutionary PHABLE photolithography systems enable inexpensive fabrication of periodic nanostructures over large areas of planar and non-planar subrstrates. This proprietary technology has wide ranging uses in photonics, optoelectronics, displays, electronics, biotechnology, telecommunication, photovoltaics, lasers, sensors and AR/VR to name a few.

Name: Oxford Instruments Femto Tools AG
Description: FemtoTools, part of the Oxford Instruments group,  develops and sells high resolution, MEMS-based nanoindenters for applications in metallurgy, thin films and microsystem technology

Name: Qnami
Description: At Qnami we develop fundamental new technology using quantum mechanics. The control and measurement of the state of a single electron enables us to measure what could never be measured before. We call this quantum sensing and we are enthusiastically developing this technique to improve people’s lives and the world.

Name: Swiss Nanoscience Institute (SNI), University of Basel
Description:
The Swiss Nanoscience Institute (SNI) at the University of Basel is a center of excellence for nanosciences and nanotechnology. It was founded in 2006 by the University of Basel and the Swiss Canton Aargau in order to support research, education, and technology transfer in nanoscience and nanotechnology in Northwestern Switzerland. The SNI focuses on the core areas of nanoimaging and nanofabrication in order to address challenges in the fields of materials science, quantum science, life science, medicine and environment.
For alumni of the nanoscience study program, we have created a specific group: https://www.linkedin.com/groups/8278038/

Name: Microcity - Neuchâtel Innovation
Description:
Microcity est le pôle d’excellence et d’innovation dans les micro-nanotechnologies, la micro-fabrication et les processus d’industrialisation.
Les membres du pôle d’innovation neuchâtelois réunissent des compétences académiques, de recherche et d'industrialisation de niveau international.  Les membres sont notamment: l'Ecole Polytechnique Fédéral de Lausanne (EPFL), le Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM); la He-Arc, l'Université de Neuchâtel (UNINE),  la Fondation Suisse pour la recherche en microtechnique (FSRM), le Centre de formation professionnel neuchâtelois (CPNE), les communes du Canton ainsi que l'Etat de Neuchâtel.

Microcity c'est une SA à but non lucratif qui propose des services d'hébergement, de coaching, des événement de réseautage mais aussi des services de project management spécialisés, des assessment technologiques et la création d'écosystèmes technologiques riches pour les PME et les instituts de recherches et d'enseignement. 

 
 - un rayonnement national et international de capacités d’innovation, notamment à travers le Swiss Innovation Park - SIP.

Name: NanoSphere
Description:
Nanomedicine Knowledge Platform, bridging lab to market.

By distilling complex research, industry trends, and regulatory, clinical, and preclinical data: CAR-T, LNPs, RNA, delivery tech, ADCs & personalized medicine into clear, actionable insights, NanoSphere accelerates nanomedicine from bench to bedside fueling scientists, regulators, startups, and investors to act, build, and scale.

What does each get out of NanoSphere?

Academics → Visibility + Industry Context
Industry → Tech scouting + BD leads
Regulators → Early risk signals across platforms
Clinicians → Signals from preclinical/clinical studies
Investors → Emerging trends platform potential

What this looks like in practice

– 8 active collaborations across academia (2) and industry (6)
– Direct participation in the COST Action on mRNA-based therapeutics 
– 150+ curated academic posts, plus living resources
– 10,000+ niche, high-intent website views
– Global reach across 40+ centers, rooted in Switzerland 
– 37 KOL interviews published in 2025
–12-person expert team (academic, industry, clinical, regulatory, business)

Tools built by scientists:
– NanoSphere GPTs trained on our own curated datasets
– N/P ratio calculator
– Nanomedicine learner
– Conference, grant & job finder
– Continuously updated resource hub: https://www.nanosphere.ch/resources-page

NanoSphere is the go-to for anyone serious about moving nanomedicine from bench to bedside.

Read. Follow. Or work with us.

Name: ELDICO Scientific AG
Description: ELDICO Scientific AG (The Electron Diffraction Company) is a Swiss technology and service company founded in 2019 and based next to the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI), a world-leading research institute for natural sciences and engineering. ELDICO develops, manufactures and commercializes solutions based on electron diffractometers, i.e. novel analytical instruments for electron-based crystallography that make it possible to investigate nano-crystalline samples. ELDICO recently launched its ED-1, the world’s first dedicated electron diffractometer. Among universities and research institutes ELDICO’s clients are researchers in large, fast-growing industries such as the pharmaceutical industry, electromobility, advanced inorganic materials and the evolving MOF/COF/SOF sector. In its Customer Experience Centre in Basel, ELDICO serves numerous academic and industrial clients with nano-crystallographic services. The company partners with leading engineering companies and component suppliers among Excillum and Dectris to deliver superior performance. www.eldico-scientific.com

Name: POSITIVE COATING
Description:
Fondée en 2004, POSITIVE COATING se distingue par le développement de solutions innovantes dans le domaine des traitements de surfaces basés sur les technologies les technologies PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) et ALD (Atomic Layer Deposition). La société compte aujourd'hui une trentaine de collaborateurs qualifiés sur son site de production et une infrastructure à la pointe de la technologie. 
Sa capacité de production industrielle, soutenue par un département d'engineering orienté vers l'innovation lui permet d'offrir son savoir-faire à une large clientèle. POSITIVE COATING possède un véritable savoir-faire sur les revêtements décoratifs pour les articles à forte valeur ajoutée réalisés en métaux et céramiques. 
POSITIVE COATING jouit d’une réputation de partenaire fiable et dynamique. L’entreprise est reconnue par les plus grandes maisons leaders dans le domaine du luxe et principalement dans le secteur de l’horlogerie. Elle propose également ses services dans les secteurs de la maroquinerie, des instruments d’écriture et de la bijouterie.
Son avenir est également très prometteur dans le domaine de la technologie médicale. POSITIVE COATING intervient dans ce secteur sur des projets liés aux dispositifs implantables et aux applications biomédicales. 
Placée au cœur d’une industrie microtechnique prestigieuse, l’entreprise contribue à l’élaboration de produits technologiques d’excellence.

Name: Swiss Cluster
Description:
Swiss Cluster AG develops innovative coating equipment for R & D and industrial production. 

Our novel and revolutionary designs challenge the industry standard in order to improve industrial process times and film quality in ALD coatings to medium to large 3D parts in different markets (semiconductor, medical, watch, optics) or fabricate new material systems by combining different deposition techniques with our SC-1 series systems. 
 
We offer R & D services and customized solutions for coating equipment, hardware/software and processes with our novel approach. 
  
Our goal is to enable researchers and companies with the tools to accelerate their next materials breakthroughs.

Name: Alemnis AG
Description: Alemnis is specialized in development, manufacturing and integration of customized instruments and tools for nanomechanical and micromechanical testing, nanoindentation and microindentation for all fields of microscopy (SEM, FIB, Light microscope, Synchrotron). The Alemnis nanoindenter range includes indentation devices for in-situ materials testing, standard and specially customized micro-/nanopositioners as well as advanced gas injection systems.

Name: The Graphene Council
Description:
The Graphene Council was founded in 2013. Today, The Graphene Council is the largest community in the world for graphene producers, developers, investors, researchers, academics, nanotechnologists, regulatory agencies, research institutes, material science specialists and even the general public. We reach more than 35,000 people with an interest in this amazing material. 

Graphene holds the potential to dramatically disrupt and positively impact an extremely broad range of industries, including;  Medicine, Sensors, Diagnostics and Testing, Electronics, Transistors, Light Processing, Energy Storage, Water Filtration, Lubricants, Nanoantennas, Corrosion and Waterproof Coatings, Thermal Management, Composite Structural Materials and many, many more.  It is truly revolutionary. 

We invite you to join The Graphene Council and be part of this incredible materials revolution! http://www.thegraphenecouncil.org

Name: Swissphotonics
Description:
Swissphotonics is a non-profit association. It is the declared goal of Swissphotonics to improve the competitiveness of its members through the support of innovation forces.

Swissphotonics serves the full field of photonics, including material processing with lasers, photonic manufacturing, imaging, photonics in life sciences, optical communication, photovoltaics and lighting.

    Swissphotonics serves companies, research organisations, and universities in the field of photonics from basic science through applied science, technology development, manufacturing to selling of photonic components and applications. We support the industry as well as research institutes in finding research partners and funding.

    Swissphotonics supports the networking within Switzerland and establishes international contacts within Europe (Photonics21, EPIC) and worldwide (OPTICA, IOA)

Name: FEMTOPRINT SA
Description:
FEMTOPRINT is a Swiss high-tech company specialising in advanced 3D glass microfabrication and femtosecond laser technology.

We transform complex ideas into high-precision glass microdevices — from feasibility studies and rapid prototyping to contract development and industrial-scale manufacturing.

Our proprietary technology enables the fabrication of complex 3D geometries directly inside transparent glass, including microchannels, optical structures, waveguides, cavities and integrated micro-optical and microfluidic features.

Unlike conventional planar manufacturing approaches, FEMTOPRINT enables true 3D, maskless and monolithic glass microfabrication, helping companies reduce alignment and assembly steps while accelerating innovation.

Our expertise supports demanding applications across:

• Photonics & Optics
• Life Sciences & Microfluidics
• MedTech
• Quantum Technologies
• Semiconductors & MEMS
• Space
• Watchmaking & Luxury
• Advanced Research & R&D

Our services cover the complete innovation journey:

→ Feasibility & Contract Development
→ Rapid Prototyping
→ Contract Manufacturing
→ Industrial Scale-Up

With Swiss engineering expertise, vertically integrated capabilities and ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 certifications, FEMTOPRINT helps technology leaders turn challenging concepts into manufacturable, high-performance glass microdevices.

Looking for a manufacturing partner for your next glass microdevice?

Let's talk.

 www.femtoprint.ch

 Follow this page for our latest updates on 3D glass microfabrication, quantum technologies, photonics and MedTech innovation.

Name: Ryf AG - Microscopy & Metrology Services
Description:
Seit 1965 verschreiben wir uns mit Leib und Seele der Mikroskopie. Der Familienbetrieb ist in dieser Zeit kontinuierlich gewachsen und hat sich zum marktführenden Unternehmen in den Bereichen Mikroskopie und optische Messsysteme entwickelt.

Name: FLUIDINOVA, S.A.
Description:
FLUIDINOVA was founded in 2005 in Portugal as a specialized manufacturer of synthetic nano-hydroxyapatite and tricalcium phosphate materials, which are commercialized worldwide for different applications, under the brand name nanoXIM.

nanoXIM•Oral Care: The key hydroxyapatite ingredients for oral care applications, to reduce dental hypersensitivity, enhance enamel remineralization and restore natural whiteness. 
Available in two different forms: water suspension (nano) and powder (micro).

nanoXIM•Medical: Synthetic highly pure hydroxyapatite (HAp) and tricalcium phosphate (TCP) materials for bone regeneration medical devices. 
Available in three different forms: pastes, powders and granules.

nanoXIM•Food: The key hydroxyapatite ingredients for functional food and food supplements, to promote bone strength, reduce bone loss and prevent dental hypersensitivy. 
Available in two different forms: water suspension (nano) and powder (micro).

nanoXIM•Research: Looking for a calcium phosphate for your research? nanoXIM products are also available for several research fields including bio-separation, catalysis, pharma, biotechnology and functionalized textiles.

Name: XRnanotech
Description: XRnanotech is an award-winning Swiss deep tech company. We offer innovative nanostructured X-ray optics with outstanding precision for high-tech applications. Our optics allow to focus ever higher-energy beams onto the smallest possible samples. This is crucial for drug discovery, medical imaging, microchip inspection or investigation of advanced materials. In this niche, we provide unique solutions for several hundred large-scale R&D beamlines and high-tech companies around the world. Our vision is to enable them to analyze yet unmeasurable nano-systems.

Name: Miraex
Description:
Quantum interconnects for broadband entanglement of quantum resources & high capacity quantum communication.

Quantum computers represent a groundbreaking approach to currently intractable problems in fields like materials science, healthcare, energy and climate change. Current qubit count is still in the 100s, whereas millions are required. To overcome this, we are developing interconnects that enable a modular approach to scaling up quantum computing hardware to the size needed, by combining different quantum processors in a distributed network.

Name: InnoMedica Holding AG
Description:
InnoMedica is a Swiss pharmaceutical company and established player in nanomedicine that is developing a new generation of nanomedicines through an innovative nanotransport system. With the first application of nanocarriers in the field of oncology, InnoMedica intends to develop an optimized chemotherapy for cancer patients. That should reduce side effects to a minimum while maintaining good efficacy.

The strategy is to develop and commercialize novel therapeutics for the treatment of tumor diseases. This new generation of chemotherapeutics uses cytostatic drugs already in common use in a new galenic form in cancer therapy.

Another application of nanocarriers is being developed in neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson's and ALS. For this purpose, InnoMedica has optimized the nanocarrier used to overcome the blood-brain barrier and used GM1 as a regenerative active ingredient. For this approach, InnoMedica has been granted orphan drug status by the FDA, EMA, and Swissmedic for use in ALS.

InnoMedica is an independent, equity-financed Swiss pharmaceutical company with its nanofactory in the canton of Fribourg.

Name: 3D AG
Description:
At 3D AG, we seamlessly blend expertise in micro & nanotechnology, high security and product digitalization to revolutionize your experience. Dedicated to pushing the boundaries of innovation, our cross-disciplinary mastery makes us uniquely positioned to transform your vision into reality.

We don't just help you keep up with the pace of innovation – we help you lead it. Trust in our expertise and state-of-the-art solutions to give you the edge you need in today's fast-evolving world.

Name: SURCOTEC SA - SURFACE COATING TECHNOLOGY
Description:
Depuis 1995, Surcotec SA parfaire sans cesse son expertise dans les revêtements.

Qu'ils soient décoratifs, réfléchissants, biocompatibles ou techniques, nous sommes votre partenaire pour traiter vos pièces en moyenne et grande série dans des critères qualités définis et respectés.

Innovant dans les technologies PVD et ALD, nous pensons et fabriquons nos machines nous offrant ainsi le champ des possibles ! Surcotec est devenue une référence dans le domaine hautement délicat de l’ingénierie des surfaces.

Une réactivité, une flexibilité et un professionnalisme reconnu nous ont permis de devenir un partenaire fiable d’un nombre toujours croissant de clients à la recherche de solutions personnalisées. De ce fait, Surcotec produit à ce jour plusieurs millions de pièces par an pour des marchés aussi divers que la microtechnique, l’optique, l’horlogerie, le médical, le spatial ou l’énergie.

 Fort d'une équipe diversifiée et qualifiée d'ingénieurs et de chefs de projet, nous nous tenons prêt à vous accompagner dans votre projet et à collaborer ensemble pour sa réussite.

Name: Argor-Aljba SA
Description:
Argor-Aljba is a service provider of nanotechnology coatings.
With over 25 years of experience, our offer includes the development and production of functional and decorative coatings.
Our latest PVD / PACVD technologies with HIPIMS methods are the basis for improving surface properties such as hardness, friction coefficient reduction, wear and corrosion resistance and biocompatibility on components in a wide range of applications.
Our ta-C Diamond-like Carbon (ta-C DLC) coatings with their exceptional characteristics offer the ideal solutions to optimize the surface tribological properties of a vast range of products: tools to machining non-ferrous materials, mechanical components (automotive, textile, packaging segments), instruments in the medical segment and high quality decorative / functional applications in the luxury segment.

We support our customers as a competent partner; with our innovative patented Dropless process we implement optimal solutions for and together with the customer. Our support begins with consulting and carrying out feasibility studies, continues with the coating of components and it is consolidated with the implementation of continuous technical improvements and information sharing with our customers.

Name: QZabre LLC
Description:
QZabre is a leading nanotechnology company based in Zurich, Switzerland providing cutting-edge scientific products for various industrial and academic applications. Our expertise lies in nitrogen vacancy (NV) magnetometry instrumentation and probes used in diverse research fields. We take pride in our unparalleled single-NV scanning tips, pillar arrays, and customized diamond solutions, which are at the forefront of nanotechnology research.
Our diamond probes are seamlessly paired with our state-of-the-art Quantum Scanning Microscope, a powerful tool for analyzing magnetic and electric fields. It offers best-in-class stability and accuracy, ideal for characterizing ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, and ferroelectric films and nanofabricated devices.
Our line-up also includes the Quantum Edukit, which makes fundamental quantum concepts accessible in a compact package. From quantum sensing principles over qubit manipulation to hands-on optics, the focus can be set on acquiring a wide range of knowledge.

Name: LS Instruments
Description:
LS Instruments AG leverages a core expertise in cutting edge light scattering technologies to address complex needs in scientific and industrial areas including biotechnology, food science, cosmetics, nanotechnology, pharmaceuticals, fundamental materials research, and more.

LS Instruments was founded as a Spin-Off that originated from the Physics Department of the University of Fribourg.

In 2007 the company moved to the incubator FriUp where the professional support allowed us to evolve into a real Start-Up. Consulting by our CTI-Coach Paul-Andre Vogel was vital for our success in these years and continues to contribute to our ongoing progress. In 2011 we made the step to move into our own office in Rte-St-Nicolas-de-Flue where LS Instruments is located today. In the same year we also received the prestigious CTI Start-Up label.

Today LS Instruments builds and develops sophisticated scientific tools to supply industry and research with the technology they need to discover the world of tomorrow.

Description: Bloesch AG is a Swiss technology pioneer with around 110 employees that develops and produces authentic coating solutions, coated components and all-in-one tailored solutions.

Name: Pointcloud Inc
Description: Pointcloud is a technology company developing high performance 3D imaging solutions.

Name: European Conference on Integrated Optics (ECIO)
Description:
The annual European Conference on Integrated Optics will take place on June 15-17, 2026, at ETH Zurich. 

The conference focuses on leading edge research on integrated optics, optoelectronics and nano-photonics and gathers experts from academia and industry to show their latest technical results, and showcase their products and services. The application scope is broad and it ranges from tele/datacom communications, optical interconnects, and (bio) optical sensing applications to more disruptive areas as quantum computing and mid-IR photonics.
  
Conference topics cover waveguide technology and platforms, devices and materials, integrated circuits and applications of photonics integrated circuits (PICs). The most recent advances in photonic integration technologies, such as silicon photonics and III-V optoelectronics, is one of the main features of the conference. Assembly, packaging and hybrid integration techniques are also present. In addition, the conference aims to discuss novel concepts on materials with unique properties such as graphene, 2D materials or phase change materials.

Name: IMT Microtechnologies
Description:
IMT has its roots in the microstructuring of metallic coatings on planar optical substrates. Over the years, we have continually added to this core expertise with complementary technologies.

Our solutions are now used in the semiconductor industry, medical technology, biophotonics, life sciences, sports optics and in optical measurement technology.

In addition to applications focusing on optical functions, the IMT product range also includes components with electronic and/or mechanical functions.

Our microfluidic components combine the full range together in one element. Etched microchannels, bores (TGV), structured metal and dielectric coatings, electronic conductors (electrodes) and optical gratings, for example, are all possible thanks to state-of-the-art semiconductor technology.

We have positioned ourselves as a service provider in the field of micro-optics and microtechnology. Development and series production is conducted exclusively on a customer-specific basis. Open cooperation based on partnership lays the foundation for mutual long-term success. Our engineers would be happy to help you on the journey from idea to series product.

Welcome to the world of IMT – Precision on Glass.  We look forward to hearing from you!

Name: MTS sa
Description: Active à La Chaux-de-Fonds depuis 2007, notre entreprise participe à la valorisation des surfaces de l’habillage horloger. Notre procédé exclusif INORYS permettant d'obtenir un acier durci, s’inscrit dans une chaîne logistique orientée vers la conservation durable de la valeur esthétique et des propriétés physiques du produit. Name: Instrumat AG
Description:
Instrumat AG is a company whose purpose is to serve as an interface between suppliers and users in the area of high technology instruments on the Swiss market. Instrumat AG is close to its partners, speaks their language and understands their demands and objectives.

Instrumat AG has been taking part in the technological activities and in the economy of Switzerland for over 20 years. The company has adapted to the rapid evolution of technology and market thanks to the men and women who make it and whose motivation is always to preserve solid partnerships.

Name: Lyncée Tec SA
Description:
DHM , the Digital Holographic Microscopes
For the first time, microscopes combine nanometric resolution, real-time and non-invasive three dimensional observation. These new instruments, based on a revolutionary patented technology called "Digital Holographic Microscopy" (DHM), are developed, manufactured and commercialized by Lyncée Tec SA.

Name: ANAXAM - Technology transfer center for advanced manufacturing
Description: ANAXAM is a technology transfer center focused on applied materials analytics using neutron and synchrotron radiation. Our analytics go far beyond what is possible at laboratory scale. We provide industry access to state-of-the-art material analytics originally developed for basic research, but now made available to address industrial challenges. We are a one-stop-shop for consultancy, measurements, analysis and interpretation of results, such that industry profits from the most advanced analytical techniques in the fields of imaging, diffraction and spectroscopy to solve their industrial problems.

Name: Ferrovac Ultra High Vacuum Technology
Description:
Ferrovac AG was founded in 1996 as a spin-off company of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETHZ) in Zurich, Switzerland.

Our main fields of activitiy are the design and production of components for ultra high vacuum technology as well as the development of scientific instruments for surface science and nanotechnology.

Ferrovac experts have profound knowledge of ultra high vacuum technology, experimental physics and scanning probe microscopy.

Our engineers work with most advanced 3D-CAD engineering technology. Thus Ferrovac is able to realize flexible solutions for various customer’s requests with reasonable lead time.

In the course of our long lasting business activity we set new standards for sample manipulation by the use and the perpetual advancement of magnetically coupled manipulators.

Our systems allow reliable loading, transferring and manipulating samples inside UHV multi chamber systems.

We are able to combine our concepts and components to complete, customer specified UHV-Systems or to refurbish existing experimental setups with our components.

Always based on the requests of our increasing number of customers, we endeavour to improve our products constantly and to adapt them to the changing needs.

Name: EVis Bioscience AG
Description:
EVis Bioscience develops innovative gene delivery systems for targeted and personalized medicine. This includes extracellular vesicles, synthetic lipid nanoparticles, and their hybrids.

Based in Zürich, the ETH spin-off aims to provide an alternative approach to viral vectors for treating genetic disorders.

Further, the company offers sub-licenses of its vehicle to Pharma Companies and/or Research Labs that intend to develop gene-based formulations for specific medical applications. 

The BSL-Class 2 laboratory is equipped with
• Microfluidics

For more information, please visit our website: www.evisbioscience.com

Name: MagnebotiX AG
Description: MagnebotiX AG is an ETH Zurich spin-off revolutionizing research with magnetic field generators and micro-agents. From our base in Zurich, we are bringing our groundbreaking technologies to researchers and innovators around the world, driving breakthroughs in micro- and nano-engineering, life sciences, and medicine.

Name: Optogan Lighting GmbH
Description:
Optogan Group is one of technology leaders developing and producing High Brightness Light Emitting Diodes (HB LEDs) for global applications including Solid State Lighting. Optogan’s geography includes R&D operation in Helsinki, Finland and Dortmund, Germany and 2 production facilities: Landshut, Germany and St. Petersburg, Russia. 

Today Optogan is ramping up high-volume manufacturing fab in St.Petersburg, Russia after acquiring a facility from Elcoteq SE in mid 2010. The operation will be launched in several phases starting end of 2010.

The Optogan group was dissolved in 2015. The rights to the Optogan brand have now been acquired by a Spanish America investment group, which focuses on the development and research of new lighting technologies.

info@optogan.com

Name: GRAPHENATON Technologies SA
Description:

Name: Lasertec
Description:
Lasertec is able to maintain its lead over the competition not only due to its in-house expertise but also as a result of its investments in cutting-edge equipment. 
 For example, Lasertec has a cleanroom with parallel production machines in place as well as a wide range of analytical and measurement facilities. The end result is that the production processes can always proceed in an uninterrupted fashion even in cases of overcapacity or rush orders.

All the production machines are set up in such a fashion as to ensure that the quality can be continuously monitored and guaranteed throughout the production process.

Name: SEALS
Description: SEALS specializes in advanced protective coatings specifically engineered for boats, using the first technology based on carbon nanotubes and synthetic nanodiamonds. Our products provide an extraordinary barrier against corrosion, UV rays, and all forms of wear and tear caused by the marine environment. This cutting-edge coating system enhances surface resistance, significantly reducing maintenance cost while preserving the marine environment.

Name: Solaronix
Description:
Solaronix is a Swiss company founded in 1993 serving a worldwide customer base with an end-to-end expertise in hybrid organic-inorganic photovoltaics, starting with the supply of specialty materials, up to the development of solar cell fabrication processes.

The company originally specialized in nanocrystalline Dye-sensitized Solar Cells, and expanded nowadays to the industrialization of metal-halide Perovskite Solar Cells.

Name: Swiss NanoAnalytics
Description:
The Swiss NanoAnalytics platform within the Adolphe Merkle Institute's BioNanomaterials group offers high quality services for the analysis of nanoparticles. This includes characterization of the physicochemical properties of nanomaterials, isolation and analysis of the occurrence of particles in food products and cosmetics, testing the stability and size of nanomedicines in biological fluids (e.g. blood serum), and testing material composites used in electronics or construction materials.

Furthermore, in connection with the development of Covid-19 vaccines or therapeutic nanocarriers (e.g. liposomal or polymer capsules), we offer characterization services, support the characterization of such vaccines or nanocarriers and provide relevant information at an early stage of development.

We offer a number of services related to the detection and analysis of nanoparticles:
- Characterization of raw materials like powders and nanoparticles (Particle size, shape or elemental composition )
- Detection of particles in consumer products such as cosmetics or food (Particle presence, size and elemental composition)
- Characterization of nanomedicines (vesicles, liposomes, polymer particles, mRNA vaccines, biomedical products, drug carriers). Particle size and colloidal stability can be analyzed in specific suspensions (physiological suspensions, plasma, cell culture medium)
- Filter efficiency measurements or on other virucidal systems (with MS2 bacteriophages)

We also offer development of procedures, consulting, training workshops (e.g. light scattering, electron microscopy, cell culture).

In-situ Microscopy Alliance (IMA) is a community of experts in electron microscopy and complementary analytical techniques with the goal of advancing technology and moving towards a sustainable future.

Its thin diamond films have various applications and the company focuses its offer of CVD-diamond coating on Microsystems, mechanical or micromechanical parts and doped-diamond electrodes.

Name: Laboratory of Semiconductor Materials - EPFL
Description:
Welcome to the Laboratory of Semiconductor Materials - LMSC

 Located within the Institute of Materials (IMX) of the School of Engineering (STI), our research sits at the dynamic intersection of materials science and physics. Led by Prof. Anna Fontcuberta i Morral,  our goal is to understand the mechanisms by which novel materials and nanostructures can be synthesized with optimal functional properties.

 Quantum Science: Creating and enabling the building blocks for next-generation computing and quantum technologies.
 Renewable Energy: sustainable materials and device design solutions for high-efficiency solar energy harvesting and photoconversion.

From the initial simulation and modeling of growth mechanisms to synthesis via Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) and Metalorganic Vapour Phase Epitaxy (MOVPE), followed by advanced structural characterization (Raman, luminescence spectroscopies) and final device integration in cleanroom environments.

 We prioritize the rational use of resources. Our mission is to enhance the sustainability of the semiconductor industry by:
- Finding and understanding how to fabricate semiconductors composed of earth-abundant elements (e.g., Zinc Phosphide, Germanium-Tin).
- Designing functional nanostructures to minimize the quantity of material required and improving performance.
- Exploring hybrid dimensionality (1D/2D) for novel properties and enhanced optoelectronic functionalities.

 Key Expertise: Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) | Nanofabrication | Nanowire technology | Semiconductors (III-V, IV, II-V, 2D) | Photovoltaics | Quantum Optoelectronics.

Name: GB Microfab
Description:
GB Microfab fonde son développement sur l’usage de moyens techniques issus des micros et nanotechnologies pour des applications en micromécanique notamment dans l’industrie horlogère.

Name: INCAPTEK
Description:
INCAPTEK Sàrl is a start-up from Switzerland developing technologies to produce a range of ultra-performance materials, from self-activating fire-extinguishing materials to ultra-low-k materials, for various industries, from electronics, automotive and aerospace to medtech. We push technological boundaries by offering ultra-performance. 

We also design smart microencapsulation solutions for cosmetics, food & beverages, etc. as well as highly innovative materials for controlled and targeted drug delivery for biotech/medtech. Name: Luminesys
Description:
Our goal is that Luminesys contributes to the detection of pathologies earlier, faster and at lower cost than before.

Luminesys IPD Increased Photon Density coatings increase the light perceived and emitted by target molecules by a factor of 3 to 25 times.
The photonic, nanostructured coatings are applied to the surface of glass slides or other supports for use with microscopes, microarray scanners and whole-slide imagers.
The coatings precisely control the increase in photon density, making the detection of molecules much more sensitive.
Our proprietary IPD technology was developed at EPFL, Switzerland to enable new generations of analyses for the detection of molecules at lower concentrations.

More light and more sensitivity for your molecular analyses

Name: Scuba Probe Technologies
Description: Scuba Probe Technologies specializes in the development and commercialization of innovative tools for scanning probe microscopy in liquids. With over 30 years of combined experience in scanning probe microscopy, our team of scientists and engineers strives to revolutionize underwater nanoscience.

Name: Stat Peel
Description:
Today’s advances in man-made nanomaterials pose new and unprecedented risks to employees along the whole value chain. Airborne, inhalable fiber-shaped nanomaterials like carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and graphene nanoplatelets (GNPs) can pose asbestos-like health risks when inhaled. Today’s available aerosol measuring devices are not capable of discerning CNT from less harmful airborne particles like pollen, dust or carbon black from diesel exhaust. 

Our high-tech but easy to use detection system can monitor an individual’s long-term exposure to nanotubes in workplaces. It allows university labs, R&D departments, start-ups, fiber producers and any company using material containing CNTs to monitor every individual employee.

Name: Swoxid
Description:
SWOXID developed a gravitational solar-thermal water purifier, which filters and sterilizes contaminated water with sunlight. It does not require electricity, nor dosage of chemical agents to provide the sterilization effect. 

The technology is based on an innovative nanoporous aerogel composite membrane which - upon solar irradiation - is able to render contaminated water safe by removing and inactivating infectious disease-causing biological agents such as bacteria, viruses, protozoa and worms. 

The SWOXID water purifier panel represents an economical and environmentally friendly option to improve global public health in line with the Sustainable Development Goal 6, especially disease prevention in the developing countries.

Description:
BebCom derives its name from the word "Beb" which means Gate in arabic. We want to open the gate leading to all the technologies needed to create a world of sensing capabilities and interaction without wires, without batteries....

We provide a full range of expertise, productivity tools and IP for Analog, RF, MEMS, that help you design better performances in a shorter time and with less risk.

Name: sgraphen
Description:
About the s graphen as private owned company.
Graphene is a remarkable material that has the potential to revolutionize a wide range of industries. However, producing graphene that is pure and free from defects can be a significant challenge. That's why it's so exciting to be part of world race for better future. s graphen made it posible to develope a uniqe method folowing several step procedures for producing high-quality graphene.

S graphen has developed a process for producing pure, oxide-free graphene that is both scalable and cost-effective. This is a major accomplishment that has the potential to transform the graphene industry and ease the stragle of world labs and researcher to hunt for better way to get as pure as posible this magical material.

S graphen production method involves using a carefully annealing and curing process to remove impurities and defects from the graphene layer. This process results in a graphene sheet that is free from oxidation and other defects, making it ideal for a wide range of applications until now it is was not posible, because of impurity and defects.

One of the key advantages of s graphen production method is that it is scalable. This means that we can produce large quantities of pure graphene to meet the needs of researchers, laboratories, and industrial customers around the world. Whether customers need just a few grams of graphene for research purposes or many tons of graphene for industrial applications, s graphen is able to meet their needs.
Another advantage of s graphen production method is that it is cost-effective.
 
S graphen insures high-quality graphene more accessible to a wider range of customers. By offering competitive pricing, your company is helping to drive the adoption of graphene across a wide range of industries. Get in touch for placing order for your production line or developing a brand new product

Name: AMSwitch
Description:
AMSwitch is developing a new class of ultra‐low‐power logic switches using altermagnetic materials—an emerging magnetic state with zero net magnetization but electrically readable signals. These devices could operate below 1 aJ per bit, approaching fundamental energy limits.


The project explores two concepts: a gate‐tunable altermagnet switch using Berry‐curvature control, and a current‐driven switch that flips the altermagnetic order for compact logic operations. Together, they aim to enable reliable, non‐volatile, and energy‐efficient computing for future edge devices.


AMSwitch unites experts across materials science, nanoscale fabrication, device engineering, quantum theory, synchrotron characterization, and magnetometry—ensuring rapid progress from discovery to technology.


AMSwitch is coordinated by Chalmers University of Technology and has received funding from the European Innovation Council and SMEs Executive Agency (EISMEA) under the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under Grant Agreement n° 101258102.

Name: SwissBN
Description:
Our scalable and high-quality two-dimensional (2D) boron nitride (BN) material enables semiconductor manufacturers to achieve faster, smaller, cooler, lighter and durable electronic devices without compromising scalability and no need of switching to a completely new material system. 

2D electronic devices fabricated based on graphene encapsulated with BN are 10x faster than Silicon-based devices, yet the dimensions are significantly reduced, which will be revolutionary for next generation electronics. At the moment, wafer-scale fabrication of graphene is already achieved. However, wafer-scale high-quality BN is the biggest challenge, which are not available on the market. We are surface physicists have worked with BN materials since 1997 and we can fabricate such highly demanding BN materials at University of Zurich.

Name: 3Wave Instruments
Description:
Next-generation materials analysis, in real time.
3Wave Instruments is an ETH Zurich spin-off delivering laser-optical second harmonic generation (SHG) to probe functional thin-film properties during growth—fast, contactless, and non-destructive. Our in-situ SHG platform turns symmetry-sensitive signals into instant insight so researchers can precisely optimize epitaxial films and multilayer heterostructures.

Key features
* Real-time, non-destructive monitoring of bulk, surface, and interface properties
* Direct probing of thickness, temperature, gas pressure and other growth parameters
* User-friendly software for seamless operation and data analysis

Benefits
* Unmatched insight into symmetry-dependent physical properties of matter
* Optimized process control for improved quality, reliability, and efficiency
* Faster research cycles, accelerated optimization, and reduced costs
